item.title: Just Released: Music Video for "The Rider" from our last studio album (Imam Baildi III) - Imam Baildi
item.description: Just released: An inspired new music video for “The Rider” from our last studio album (Imam Baildi III). Karagiozis, the famous traditional Greek shadow theatre character, makes a journey in modern Athens, in search of his soulmate. Produced by Sam3 (www.sam3.es) and Daniel Almoril (www.danielalmoril.com), Athens, 2016.

item.title: Babel Med Music - Imam Baildi
item.description: This year Imam Baildi have been chosen to perform in one of the most significant music forums in Europe. Babel Med Music, hosted in Marseille, France, welcomes more than 2500 music professionals each year, and is dedicated to promoting world music. Imam Baildi will perform on March 16th.
